title: 团建吃住行均摊计算器
prompt: 我们团建出行帮我根据吃住行计划计算人均均摊
program:
root = Col([intro, tool, interpretation, closing])

$people = 12
$food = 3600
$hotel = 9600
$transport = 2400
$details = false

intro = Text("先填写参与人数，再录入吃、住、行三项总额，系统会自动计算总费用和人均均摊。以下金额为**示例数据**，可直接修改；本工具只做均摊计算，不涉及任何预订或支付。")
inputs = Col([Row([Input($people, "参与人数", "number"), Input($food, "餐饮总额（元）", "number")], 2), Row([Input($hotel, "住宿总额（元）", "number"), Input($transport, "交通总额（元）", "number")], 2)], 3)
summary = Text("总费用 " + totalText + " · 人均 " + perText, "md", "ink", "medium")
detailFood = Row([Caption("餐饮"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(pf, "number", 2) + " / 人", "sm")], 2)
detailHotel = Row([Caption("住宿"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(ph, "number", 2) + " / 人", "sm")], 2)
detailTransport = Row([Caption("交通"), Spacer(), Text("¥" + @Format(pt, "number", 2) + " / 人", "sm")], 2)
details = Col([Divider(), Title("各项人均", "sm"), detailFood, detailHotel, detailTransport], 2)
footer = [Button("复制人均结果", @CopyToClipboard(copyText), "solid", "primary", null, "copy"), Button($details ? "收起明细" : "查看明细", @Set($details, !$details), "soft", null, null, $details ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down")]
tool = TravelModule([inputs, summary, $details ? details : null], "budget", "团建人均均摊", "示例数据，可修改；仅做均摊计算", footer)
interpretation = Text("结果会随人数或金额变化即时更新。请确认三项总额是否包含所有集体开销，例如餐饮是否含酒水、住宿是否含早餐、交通是否含往返大交通，避免漏项后再定人均。")
closing = Text("如果部分项目只由部分同事参与，建议先按实际参与名单单独记录，再按对应人数分摊，不要把所有金额直接除以总人数。")

people = @Clamp(@Default($people, 1), 1, 100)
food = @Clamp(@Default($food, 0), 0, 1000000)
hotel = @Clamp(@Default($hotel, 0), 0, 1000000)
transport = @Clamp(@Default($transport, 0), 0, 1000000)
total = food + hotel + transport
per = @Round(total / people, 2)
pf = @Round(food / people, 2)
ph = @Round(hotel / people, 2)
pt = @Round(transport / people, 2)
totalText = "¥" + @Format(total, "number", 2)
perText = "¥" + @Format(per, "number", 2)
copyText = "团建费用均摊：总费用 ¥" + @Format(total, "number", 2) + "；参与人数 " + people + " 人；人均 ¥" + @Format(per, "number", 2)
